scope: Shared configured workspace count forwarded by existing KDE bridge into an in-memory compositor mirror, without preference-file IO in the frontend

contract.authority: effective_options() from existing common config and user text overrides; no new preference/file
contract.idempotence: Same value does not increase revision or schedule another reconciliation
contract.knownValue: Retain last valid count after invalid command/partial file/IPC error; do not announce provider before the first valid mirror
contract.effect: workspaceSnapshot uses mirror, retains live/active workspaces outside configured range, excludes specials and legacy99; no creation/removal of compositor workspaces
contract.bridge: Existing watcher/debounce, same Runtime for reconcile/watch, 2-second installed-module retry check, no new daemon/watcher/thread/timer
contract.serialization: Existing bridge.lock, nonblocking attempt from tick with 0.25s retry; already-held guard reused in reconcile; no lock/process wait on compositor thread
contract.installationGate: No IPC unless optional module exists in standard installation path; its presence never loads/enables the module
contract.frontend: No file_size, ifstream or JSON config parse in refresh/apply; 500ms reconciliation reads only compositor state and memory mirror
contract.launcher: Read-only preflight requires countMirrorVersion exactly integer1 and configuredCountAvailable true in addition to previous guards. Does not forward settings/install/load/enable
contract.freshness: Known cache is last accepted value, not instantaneous preference freshness or graphical certification

assertions: Installed absence performs no count IPC, option read or file creation
Forwarded value comes from effective options rather than directly reading raw JSON
Python emitter is checked against actual C++ parser/receipt for1/7/100 over private transport
Malformed/boolean/wrong/missing/unconfirmed receipts do not count as success
Duplicate commands preserve revision and invalid commands preserve the last value
Original KDE consumer receives3→7 and reduction to2 preserves live3 and active7 in raw and arbitrated fixtures
Actual bridge test uses shared12, then user override9, preserves user/unknown file content and reentry behavior, without count-triggered reload
A partial JSON edit does not send a replacement value and subsequent valid12 is forwarded
Busy existing lock does not block watch or send IPC, then retries; reconcile never locks recursively
Launcher rejects older count capabilities or unavailable count without mutating the provider
limitations: Real Hyprland count-command/frontend/startup and post-skin-change delivery are not validated by these fixtures
Emitter/parser combined fixture uses private transport, not real hyprctl or compositor sockets
Optional plugin remains uninstalled/unloaded and no live bridge restart was performed
Existing running bridge must restart or start in a new login to adopt native_workspaces.py
Periodic forwarding is gated on the standard installed-module path
Last valid value can be stale until the next successful serialized/debounced bridge pass; configuredCountAvailable is not freshness certification
Serialization covers cooperating bridge writers, not arbitrary same-user IPC clients or external editors
No physical surfaces/input/Task.qml rendering or panel authority/fallback acceptance
Leak sanitizer disabled, no memory-leak certification; single-generation policy remains

The existing KDE watch exits outside Breeze; configured count can remain the last Breeze snapshot until reentry while the live workspace feed continues. Continuous count delivery across all skins remains pending before daily integration
